Hi Tamara / Jorge —

Thanks again for your time on today’s demo. Quick recap and clear next steps so our security and engineering teams can move confidently: 

1) Compliance posture you asked about:
   - SOC 2: Redwood has SOC 2 Type II in progress; we can share the SOC 2 Type I report and our controls matrix now.
   - HIPAA: We provide a BAA; happy to start that conversation with your legal team.
   - GDPR: Data residency and DPIA patterns are in our privacy pack — will include the privacy FAQ.

2) IAM-specific asks we discussed (SSO / SCIM / admin controls):
   - SAML SSO: Tamara requested SAML metadata and IdP/ACS endpoints.
   - SCIM: Ava wants attribute mapping (email, externalId, groups) and provisioning cadence.
   - RBAC/admin: Screenshot or doc of admin role permissions and audit log retention.

Action items / who: 
   - David (me): send initial evidence bundle and SSO/SCIM implementation guide by EOD tomorrow.
   - Monica (solutions): provide SCIM attribute map and recommended provisioning flows; confirm out-of-the-box group sync behavior.
   - Rishi (security): add SOC 2 Type I and the controls matrix; note any known gaps and remediation timelines.

We aim to get the vendor questionnaire filled (attached) and the technical artifacts over so your security review can proceed this week. Proposed timeline: questionnaire returned + SAML metadata by Tue (2027-08-24), SCIM mapping by Wed (2027-08-25).

Attachments I will send: vendor-questionnaire-AvaHealth.docx (please review), redwood-sso-implementation-guide.pdf (technical), scim-attribute-mapping.csv (draft).

If you prefer a quick 30-min technical call with Monica to walk SCIM mapping, let us know 2 available slots.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Post-demo: IAM evidence request & next steps for SSO/SCIM

Hi Tamara —

Thanks — looping in details below and attaching the SCIM attribute CSV and SSO guide links. Replying inline to your bullets: 

> For SAML: we need the SP metadata (entityID, ACS URL, cert thumbprint) and confirmation of support for IdP-initiated flows.

- SP metadata: entityID = https://api.redwood.com/sp/avahealth, ACS = https://api.redwood.com/saml/acs, singleLogout = https://api.redwood.com/saml/slo.
- Certificate: we rotate signing certs annually; current thumbprint = E3:4A:7B:... (we'll send full cert PEM in the Drive link).
- IdP-initiated: supported; RelayState is honored for deep-linking to routes in the console.

> For SCIM: AVA's provisioning team expects these attributes: userName, externalId, givenName, familyName, email, active, groups; we also want group membership sync and deprovisioning behavior documented.

- SCIM v2 endpoint: https://api.redwood.com/scim/v2
- Attributes supported (see attached scim-attribute-mapping.csv): userName, id (externalId), givenName, familyName, email, active, groups[].
- Group sync: we support push provisioning of groups; changes to group membership are reflected within 60 seconds in most cases.
- Deprovisioning: disable user -> user.active = false; by default we keep the user resource for 90 days before purging (configurable for Dedicated/Private customers).

> RBAC/admin: Screenshot or doc of admin role permissions and audit log retention.

- Audit logs capture admin actions (role assignment, model rollout, key changes) and are retained 365 days in hosted by default; we can provide exports or set a longer retention on Dedicated.

Attachments/links included:
- (attached) scim-attribute-mapping.csv — CSV of attribute names + example values
- (link) https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-redwood-ava-ssomap — full SAML cert PEM and implementation guide
- (attached) redwood-sso-implementation-guide.pdf — step-by-step for your SSO admin

We'll start filling the vendor questionnaire and send a draft back by end of day Monday (2027-08-23). If the 09:00 PST slot on Tue 2027-08-24 works, Monica can host the SCIM deep-dive then.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
